general_exclusion_criteria:
Poor performance status (ECOG greater than 1, unless ECOG 2 is due to lymphoma)
Renal dysfunction (creatinine clearance less than or equal to 45 mL/min)
Cardiac dysfunction (ejection fraction less than 45%)
Respiratory dysfunction (resting O2 saturation less than or equal to 90% on room air)

Known history of infection with human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) or active hepatitis B (HBsAg positive)
Known history of infection with hepatitis C virus unless viral load is undetectable per quantitative PCR and/or nucleic acid testing
Pharmacologically uncontrolled seizures
Known history or presence of autoimmune central nervous system disease or other immunologic or inflammatory disease
Presence of central nervous system disorder that may impair the ability to evaluate neurotoxicity
For central nervous system cohort: midline shift on MRI or abnormal high CSF opening pressure or CSF protein greater than 150 mg/dL
Recent whole brain radiotherapy (within 3 months)
Active systemic fungal, viral, or bacterial infection
Pregnant or breast-feeding women
Previous or concurrent malignancy (excluding adequately treated basal cell or squamous cell carcinoma, in situ carcinoma of the cervix or breast treated curatively and recurrence-free for at least 2 years, adequately treated breast or prostate carcinoma on hormonal therapies in remission for at least 2 years, or primary malignancy completely resected/treated with curative intent and in complete remission for at least 2 years)
Severely immunocompromised subjects

Concurrent radiotherapy (excluding normal tissue sparing palliative radiotherapy)
Baseline dementia that would interfere with therapy or monitoring
History of severe immediate hypersensitivity reaction to any of the agents used in the study

Cancer burden allowed: Platinum-refractory or platinum-resistant and advanced. Prior treatment required: Standard of care systemic therapy or no standard therapy available. Prior treatment excluded: Antibody-drug conjugate with a topoisomerase I payload. Biomarkers required: NA. Biomarkers excluded: NA.
general_exclusion_criteria:
Poor performance status (ECOG > 1).
Active or progressing brain metastases or evidence of leptomeningeal disease.
Persistent toxicities from previous systemic antineoplastic treatments of Grade > 1, excluding alopecia and vitiligo.
Clinically significant lung disease requiring systemic corticosteroid treatment (e.g., interstitial pneumonia, pneumonitis, pulmonary fibrosis, and severe radiation pneumonitis) or suspected such diseases by imaging at screening.
Acute or chronic pancreatitis and/or any cirrhosis except Child-Pugh class A.
Hepatic insufficiency manifesting as clinical jaundice, hepatic encephalopathy, and/or variceal bleed.
History of liver transplant.
Prior allogeneic bone marrow transplantation.
Significant cardiac disease (e.g., recent myocardial infarction, acute coronary syndromes, congestive heart failure New York Heart Association class III or IV, uncontrolled hypertension, uncontrolled cardiac arrhythmias, severe aortic stenosis).
History of thromboembolic or cerebrovascular events (e.g., transient ischemic attacks, cerebrovascular accidents, deep vein thrombosis, or pulmonary emboli).
Acute and/or clinically significant bacterial, fungal, or viral infection including hepatitis B, hepatitis C, or human immunodeficiency virus (unless meeting specific stability criteria).
Known or suspected allergy to the study drug or its components.
Concurrent participation in another investigational clinical trial.
